cleansingStrength.rationale: Low is favored by CAPB #3 plus mild anionic SCI #4 and late nonionic Coco-Glucoside #19, with Glyceryl Oleate #11 refatting. Moderate is the nearest alternative because surfactant actives are unknown; neither sulfate-free naming nor Aloe #2 alone determines mildness.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate rinse-off care from Glyceryl Oleate #11 with cationic guar #17 and supporting emollient esters #16/#21. Above low because refatting plus substantive polymer form a coherent system; below high without rich fatty-alcohol/quat/silicone or 2-in-1 architecture. Amino acids do not prove repair.

weightPotential.rationale: Low whole-formula weight potential: bounded refatting and one cationic guar route, without a rich nonvolatile oil/fatty-alcohol/silicone load. Moderate remains possible with unusually efficient guar deposition, but polymer presence and weak reset alone do not create a moderate floor.

focusPrimary.rationale: Blind default only. Exact product intent is hidden; formula suggests mild cleansing/care but v1.4 claims must select and formula must gate the final focus.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty provisional default; no distinct exact-product secondary claims are visible. This is not a final no-claim finding.

usageRole.rationale: Regular is the v1.4 default pending exact directions/positioning. Frequent cannot be inferred merely from low cleansing.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Formula supports a possible mild/refatting context but Parfum #9 is an exposure counter-signal, and scalp intent is hidden. Root must resolve the claim-gated targeted/not_targeted choice.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole occurs in the complete supplied 33-ingredient sequence. Aloe/amino acids/humectants do not establish cosmetic anti-dandruff support.

false_signal_notes: Sodium Isethionate #18 is not counted as another strong anionic cleansing surfactant.
Glycol Distearate #16 supports emulsion/pearlescence context, not an independent repair technology.
Free amino acids are not hydrolyzed protein or proof of structural repair.

weightAssessment.counterEvidence: Mild reset does not remove all residue, and cationic guar can deposit; realistic supplier/formulation differences could move adjacent band.
weightAssessment.whyThisBand: Limited nonvolatile payload and no demonstrated persistent film favor low after full architecture assessment.
weightAssessment.whyNotNeighborBand: Moderate requires meaningfully persistent interacting material; one guar plus bounded refatter is not sufficient evidence by route count.

thicknessAssessments.rationale: Low weight plus bounded conditioning supports a broad fine-hair prior; not a guarantee of root lift.
Low cleansing and moderate conditioning support ordinary normal-diameter use; scalp loading still governs suitability.
Limited high-deposition care leaves coarse/high-care needs conditional; formula-only evidence does not establish ideal fit across those needs.

limitations: INCI-only E2 potential; ranks are literal order, not concentrations. No finished-product deposition, performance, pH, molecular-weight or repeated-use data.
Exact identity and current primary-source binding are held by root and remain hidden from this assessor. No catalog or prior labels used.
No claim of suitability for color-treated hair or protocol inferred.
